## Installation

<docs.Tabs sync="install">
<docs.TabItem label="CLI">

Run the command in the app module.

```sh frame="terminal" title="Terminal"
gx add date-picker
```

The command also installs [`calendar`](/components/calendar/) and [`popover`](/components/popover/).

The command writes these files.

| File | Path in the app |
| --- | --- |
| `DatePicker.gx` | `ui/date-picker/DatePicker.gx` |
| `DatePicker.fixtures.go` | `ui/date-picker/DatePicker.fixtures.go` |
| `styles.go` | `ui/date-picker/styles.go` |

</docs.TabItem>
<docs.TabItem label="Manual">

Install [`calendar`](/components/calendar/) and [`popover`](/components/popover/) first.

Copy each file to its path in the app. Change each import of a registry package to the path of that package in the app.

```gx title="ui/date-picker/DatePicker.gx"
package datepicker

import "github.com/alternayte/gx/registry/calendar"
import "github.com/alternayte/gx/registry/popover"

props {
  // Id is the id of the date input. A label points at it.
  Id          string
  // Name is the form field name. The form sends the day as YYYY-MM-DD.
  Name        string = ""
  // Value is the chosen day of the first render, as YYYY-MM-DD.
  Value       string = ""
  // Min is the first day that a user can choose, as YYYY-MM-DD.
  Min         string = ""
  // Max is the last day that a user can choose, as YYYY-MM-DD.
  Max         string = ""
  // Placeholder is the text of the trigger with no chosen day.
  Placeholder string = "Pick a date"
  // Label is the accessible name of the date input.
  Label       string = "Date"
  // WeekStart is the first day of the week: calendar.Sunday or calendar.Monday.
  WeekStart   calendar.WeekStart = calendar.Sunday
  // Locale is the language of the month and day names, as a BCP 47 tag. Empty means the language of the page.
  Locale      string = ""
  // Class adds classes to the root element.
  Class       string = ""
  // Attrs adds HTML attributes to the date input.
  Attrs       gx.Attrs = nil
}

<div data-slot="date-picker" class={gx.Cx("inline-block", p.Class)}>
  <popover.PopoverTrigger id={p.popoverID()} class={triggerClass}>
    <span id={p.displayID()} data-empty={p.empty()} class={displayClass}>{p.text()}</span>
  </popover.PopoverTrigger>
  <popover.Popover id={p.popoverID()} align={popover.Start} class="w-auto p-0">
    <calendar.Calendar id={p.Id} name={p.Name} value={p.Value} min={p.Min} max={p.Max} label={p.Label} weekStart={p.WeekStart} locale={p.Locale} display={p.displayID()} popover={p.popoverID()} class="border-0" attrs={p.Attrs} />
  </popover.Popover>
</div>
```

```go title="ui/date-picker/DatePicker.fixtures.go"
package datepicker

import (
	"github.com/alternayte/gx"
	"github.com/alternayte/gx/registry/calendar"
)

var DatePickerFixtures = gx.Fixtures[DatePickerProps]{
```

```go title="ui/date-picker/styles.go"
// Package datepicker is a button that opens a calendar in a popover.
package datepicker

// triggerClass is the classes of the trigger button: as wide as a date and
// with its text at the start.
const triggerClass = "w-64 justify-start font-normal"

// displayClass is the classes of the text of the trigger. The placeholder
// is muted.
const displayClass = "truncate data-[empty=true]:text-muted-foreground"

// popoverID returns the id of the popover.
func (p DatePickerProps) popoverID() string { return p.Id + "-popover" }

// displayID returns the id of the element that shows the chosen day.
func (p DatePickerProps) displayID() string { return p.Id + "-display" }

// empty reports, as an attribute value, whether no day is chosen.
func (p DatePickerProps) empty() string {
	if p.Value == "" {
		return "true"
	}
	return "false"
}

// text returns the text of the trigger for the first render: the day as
// the server has it, or the placeholder. The calendar island writes the day
// in the language of the user.
func (p DatePickerProps) text() string {
	if p.Value != "" {
		return p.Value
	}
	// A props value that Go code makes has no default.
	if p.Placeholder == "" {
		return "Pick a date"
	}
	return p.Placeholder
}
```

</docs.TabItem>
</docs.Tabs>

The theme must define these tokens: `--muted-foreground`.

## Usage

```gx
<label for="due">Due date</label>
<datepicker.DatePicker id="due" name="due" value={p.Due} />
<datepicker.DatePicker id="start" name="start" min="2026-10-10" max="2026-10-20" placeholder="Start date" />
```

The component is a popover with a calendar. The calendar holds a native `<input type="date">`, so a form sends the day as `YYYY-MM-DD`.
The button shows the chosen day in the language of the user. A choice closes the popover.
With no script the button opens the popover, and the popover shows the date input of the browser.

## API reference

A tag sets a prop by its name with a lower-case first letter: `Class` is `class`.

### datepicker.DatePicker

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Id` | `string` | Required | Id is the id of the date input. A label points at it. |
| `Name` | `string` | `""` | Name is the form field name. The form sends the day as YYYY-MM-DD. |
| `Value` | `string` | `""` | Value is the chosen day of the first render, as YYYY-MM-DD. |
| `Min` | `string` | `""` | Min is the first day that a user can choose, as YYYY-MM-DD. |
| `Max` | `string` | `""` | Max is the last day that a user can choose, as YYYY-MM-DD. |
| `Placeholder` | `string` | `"Pick a date"` | Placeholder is the text of the trigger with no chosen day. |
| `Label` | `string` | `"Date"` | Label is the accessible name of the date input. |
| `WeekStart` | `calendar.WeekStart` | `calendar.Sunday` | WeekStart is the first day of the week: calendar.Sunday or calendar.Monday. |
| `Locale` | `string` | `""` | Locale is the language of the month and day names, as a BCP 47 tag. Empty means the language of the page. |
| `Class` | `string` | `""` | Class adds classes to the root element. |
| `Attrs` | `gx.Attrs` | `nil` | Attrs adds HTML attributes to the date input. |

## Do and do not

<docs.CardGrid>
<docs.Card title="Do">

- Give the date picker a `<label>` for its `Id`.
- Set `Min` and `Max` for a range of valid days. The server checks the value too.
- Use a `Placeholder` that names the date, for example "Start date".

</docs.Card>
<docs.Card title="Don't">

- Do not use a date picker for a date of birth. Use three inputs or one text input.
- Do not put a date picker in a popover.

</docs.Card>
</docs.CardGrid>

## Keyboard

| Key | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Tab | Moves focus to the button. |
| Enter, Space | Opens the calendar from the button, or chooses the day that has the focus. |
| Arrow keys | Moves one day or one week in the calendar. |
| Page Up, Page Down | Moves one month back or forward. |
| Escape | Closes the calendar and moves focus to the button. |
